description: This PHP class 'QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware' inspects and casts command input values to their modeled types for AWS services that use query or JSON protocols. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP and handles input validation and type casting for service commands.

classes.name: QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that inspects and casts input parameters for AWS SDK commands to their expected types, supporting query and JSON protocols.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that includes the service context, returning a middleware instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the next handler and the service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Processes the command input, adjusting types as needed before passing control to the next handler.

methods.name: processInput
methods.description: Recursively processes a given input shape, casting values to their modeled types.

methods.name: processStructure
methods.description: Processes input of shape 'structure', recursively inspecting properties.

methods.name: processList
methods.description: Processes input of shape 'list', recursively inspecting items.

methods.name: processMap
methods.description: Processes input of shape 'map', inspecting key-value pairs.

methods.name: processScalar
methods.description: Processes scalar input, casting it if it does not match the modeled type, and issuing a warning.

methods.name: changeValueAtPath
methods.description: Modifies the input command in place at a specific nested path.

methods.name: isModeledType
methods.description: Checks if a value matches its expected modeled type.

methods.name: castValue
methods.description: Casts a value to a specified type.
